fields.name: Honey
fields.description: a sweet, thick liquid made by bees using flower nectar. Bees collect the nectar, break down its natural sugars, and store it in wax honeycombs inside their hives. People use honey as a food sweetener, a natural cough remedy, and an ointment for minor skin wounds.
